messages:
Jordan (Hiring Manager): FYI new Senior PM Evan starts Tues 10am PT. Need a compact manager one-pager and a simple 30/60/90 I can attach to the welcome email. Keep it action-oriented.
Tess (People Ops): Got it. I'll draft a single-page checklist managers can forward. Want it to include manager deliverables?
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Yes 10. Manager responsibilities and expected checkpoints (1wk, 30d, 90d). Also quick who-to-ask handles.
Riley (IT): From IT: confirm laptop preference and whether they need Docker+GPU. We usually image 48hrs before start. If account invites bounce, open ticket at @it-help with screenshots.
Nora (Buddy): I'm available as buddy. I'll do an onboarding walkthrough and a team lunch. Can we reserve 45m on day 1 for team intro + system tour?
Tess (People Ops): Draft below. Keep it short for an offer email.
Tess (People Ops): MANAGER ONE-PAGER (copy/paste friendly)
- Pre-boarding (Day -3 to -1): Confirm laptop model (mac/linux), shipping address, personal email for calendar invites. Add new hire to Slack channels: #product, #announcements, #team-ops.
- Day 1 AM: 10:00 welcome w/manager (20m), meet team (30-40m), IT setup check (20m), lunch w/buddy (30m).
- Day 1 PM: HR quick benefits walk (20m), enable SSO/Okta/MFA, ensure repo read access, assign first small onboarding task (doc or bug).
- Days 2-4: Product demos, customer context, shadowing sessions across infra & platform.
- Day 5: Sync w/manager to review environment access, set 30-day goals.
- End of week 2: Draft 30/60/90 and share with manager for feedback.

Tess (People Ops): WHO TO CONTACT (short list)
- IT: @it-help 10 laptop/images, credentials
- Security: @security_ops 10 SSO/MFA/policies
- Facilities: @fac 10 badge & parking
- Benefits/Payroll: @people-ops 10 onboarding forms
- Buddy: @Nora 10 day-to-day culture/questions

Tess (People Ops): 30/60/90 (two-line manager prompts)
- 30 days: "Confirm onboarding tasks complete, has read access to core repos and staging, shipped a small contribution (doc, bug/mini feature), met core stakeholders."
- 60 days: "Lead a small cross-functional effort, own a roadmap slice, show initial performance against KPIs, improve a process."
- 90 days: "Independently run planning, deliver a measurable outcome that maps to OKRs, onboard another teammate (knowledge sharing)."

Tess (People Ops): MANAGER COMMITMENTS
- Weekly 1:1 (30m) for first 12 weeks.
- 30- and 90-day review checkpoints scheduled up-front.
- Provide initial scoped task within Week 1 and timely feedback (within 10 business days).

Riley (IT): Addendum: If hardware delayed use cloud workstation: https://workstation.redwood.internal/login (use temporary token request at @it-help). Grant read-only CI/staging by Day 2; deploy rights after security signoff.

Nora (Buddy): Welcome blurb template for #team channel:
"Say hi to @Evan! Evan joins as Sr PM on Tues 10am PT. Buddy: @Nora. We'll do a 10am welcome + lunch. Ping Nora for quick demos or docs." :wave:

Jordan (Hiring Manager): Love this. Can you also include a suggested first-week mini-deliverable for PMs? Keeps them engaged.

Tess (People Ops): Suggestion: "First-week deliverable: write a 1-page problem statement + success metrics for an immediate small improvement (parking lot item or bug). Share with manager by Friday."

Evan (New hire): Thanks all! Quick Q: will I have access to bug tracker & product analytics day 1?

Riley (IT): You should have view access to bug tracker and analytics by Day 2. If you need earlier access for triage, open @it-help ticket and cc your manager.

Jordan (Hiring Manager): Perfect 10 I'll attach this to the offer note. Tess, can you drop a final one-paragraph offer-ready line I can paste?

Tess (People Ops): Offer line: "Welcome to Redwood! Attached is a short first-week agenda and a simple 30/60/90 outline. We'll provision accounts before Day 1; if anything is missing reply here or contact IT at @it-help. Your buddy @Nora will meet you for lunch on Day 1. We're excited to have you aboard!"

Jordan (Hiring Manager): Sending now. Thanks team :rocket:
